description:
Autopilot is a visual marketing automation platform that uses AI for journey mapping, segmentation, and personalized messaging across email, SMS, and in-app notifications.

Ortto’s marketing automation and customer data platform unifies your data, messaging and analytics on a single platform.

Visual journey mapping and automation. AI-powered audience segmentation. Personalized messaging across channels. Multi-channel campaign delivery.

pricing.label: Premium
pricing.note: Price label carried over from the previous catalog and not rechecked.

howToUse.title: Sign Up & Set Up Workspace
howToUse.description: Register for Autopilot and log in. Set up your workspace and connect your website, CRM, or database.

howToUse.title: Map Customer Journeys
howToUse.description: Use the drag-and-drop builder to visually design journeys—automate actions, triggers, and audience flows for every stage.

howToUse.title: Segment Audiences with AI
howToUse.description: Leverage AI tools to segment lists by behavior, demographics, or engagement for targeted messaging.

howToUse.title: Create and Send Campaigns
howToUse.description: Build multi-channel campaigns across email, SMS, and in-app notifications. Personalize content for each segment.

howToUse.title: Track and Optimize
howToUse.description: Monitor campaign performance in real time. Use analytics and reporting to optimize journeys and boost results.
